name_reason: Fully compliant: data_fd2_ prefix (game global) + audio domain + descriptor fdother_sfx_bank_buf_ptr that captures source file (FDOTHER), purpose (SFX sample bank base), and data type (buffer pointer, _ptr suffix). The 0x1F resource index is not embedded in the name (no need), and there is no Ghidra-address residue (no hex suffix matching 0x53eec or any data address). Name correctly reflects both purpose and that the slot is a pointer.
purpose: Base pointer of the loaded SFX sample bank (FDOTHER.DAT resource index 0x1F); the in-bank sample directory used by the AIL one-shot SFX dispatchers.
logic_summary: 32-bit address slot holding the malloc'd buffer returned by fd2_load_dat_resource(FDOTHER.DAT, prior_value, 0x1F). Sole writer is main @0x25BF4 at boot, which performs a read-modify-write (read at 0x25c65, store at 0x25c78) passing the prior value (NULL first time) so the loader frees-then-reloads. ~55 reader sites across battle/field/menu/dialog/save/anim pass it as the bank_base argument of fd2_play_sfx_with_handle (@0x25a96) and fd2_play_sfx_sample_from_bank (@0x25b45). Those dispatchers treat it as a 4-byte-stride sample directory: entry = bank_base + sfx_id*4; sample_offset = *(uint*)(entry+6); sample_end = *(uint*)(entry+10); AIL_set_sample_address(handle, bank_base + sample_offset, sample_end - sample_offset). Cross-checked against resource_info/fdother.md which names this exact symbol for idx 0x1F (nested archive, 13 sub-entries).
datatype: uint32 (Ghidra undefined4) -- a 32-bit DAT-resource buffer pointer slot stored as a plain address word, matching siblings data_fd2_resource_portrait_sheet_ptr / data_fd2_ui_anim_sprite_sheet_ptr.
element_semantics: Single scalar pointer to the base of the FDOTHER idx 0x1F SFX sample bank. At bank_base + sfx_id*4 sits a directory entry whose +6 dword = sample start offset within the bank and +10 dword = sample end offset (length = end - start).
comment_original_issue: src comment in main.c is detailed and accurate (idx 0x1F source, sole writer free-then-reload pattern, reader directory layout, BSS zero-init). It says '~50 sites' where the live xref count is ~55, but '~' marks it as an approximation, not a defect; kept as-is.
notes: Ghidra data plate migrated from the legacy PRE_COMMENT field to PLATE_COMMENT via run_script_inline (per project_ghidra_data_plate_mechanism); legacy PRE_COMMENT cleared to avoid duplication; PLATE content reflects the src conclusion (precise ~55 reader count).
